entries.title: I Timothy 2:1
segments: ¶Therefore I exhort first of all that supplications, prayers, intercessions, [and] giving of thanks be made for all men,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:2
segments: for kings and all who are in authority, that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and reverence.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:3
segments: For this [is] good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:4
segments: who desires all men to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:5
segments: For [there is] one God and one Mediator between God and men, [the] Man Christ Jesus,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:6
segments: who gave Himself a ransom for all, to be testified in due time,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:7
segments: for which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle--I am speaking the truth in Christ [and] not lying--a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:8
segments: I desire therefore that the men pray everywhere, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting;

entries.title: I Timothy 2:9
segments: ¶in like manner also, that the women adorn themselves in modest apparel, with propriety and moderation, not with braided hair or gold or pearls or costly clothing,

entries.title: I Timothy 2:10
segments: but, which is proper for women professing godliness, with good works.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:11
segments: Let a woman learn in silence with all submission.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:12
segments: And I do not permit a woman to teach or to have authority over a man, but to be in silence.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:13
segments: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:14
segments: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived, fell into transgression.

entries.title: I Timothy 2:15
segments: Nevertheless she will be saved in childbearing if they continue in faith, love, and holiness, with self-control.
